definitions.gloss: stubborn, inflexible, set in one's ways
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is unwilling to accept new ideas or change their way of thinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦うち→うち：27540_uchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い。
examples.english: My father is set in his ways.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm having trouble with my inflexible boss.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんなに→そんなに：01646_sonnani⟧{頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Don't be so rigid about it.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦こない→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: If you're inflexible, new ways of thinking won't get through to you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧{頭|あたま}が{固|かた}くて、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧「⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦こう→こう：01157_kou⟧だった」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{柔軟|じゅうなん}→柔軟：13101_juunan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: Despite being young, he's rigid and always says 'that's how it's always been.' I wish he'd think more flexibly.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧ (head) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{固|かた}い→固い：12090_katai⟧ (hard). Literally 'one's head is hard' - implying thoughts can't get through or change.

ANTONYM: ⟦{頭|あたま}が{柔|やわ}らかい→頭が柔らかい：30598_atamagayawarakai⟧ (flexible in thinking, open-minded)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧ (stubborn) - more general stubbornness
- ⟦{融通|ゆうずう}→融通：10914_yuuzuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}かない→利く：11845_kiku⟧ (inflexible, unbending)
- ⟦{保守的|ほしゅてき}→保守的：06176_hoshuteki⟧ (conservative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い: unwilling to change thinking
- ⟦{頭|あたま}がいい→頭がいい：20316_atamagaii⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: intelligence (smart/not smart)
- ⟦{石頭|いしあたま}→石頭：30599_ishiatama⟧ (stone head) - even stronger criticism of stubbornness

NUANCE: Often used critically, implying the person should be more open-minded.
